prompt:
Subject: Greenery Looking Up at White Flowers

Main Figure:
A chest-down side-profile portrait of a young woman in a white one-piece swimsuit looking up at the sky, surrounded by tall white flowers and deep green leaves. The subject is positioned prominently from the bottom-left to the center, showing her face tilted upward, long flower stalks, overhead white flowers, and a bright blue sky.

Person/Expression:
An oval face turned to the right with the neck extended and chin tilted high, gazing at the flowers with dark brown eyes. Quiet side profile with thin dark eyebrows, a small straight nose, and slightly parted coral lips. Radiant skin under the sun with pink cheeks and a sheen of fine sweat. Dark brown hair tied low and small, with wet bangs and long loose strands falling over the forehead, cheeks, and neck.

Clothing/Pose:
White one-piece swimsuit. Thin straps, a very deep U-neckline, low-cut sides, and fine white texture. Posed kneeling or crouching low among tall flowers, leaning the upper body slightly forward to the right. Shoulders down, arms hidden in leaf shadows and the bottom edge, focusing on the extended neck and upward profile.

Background/Light:
Large dark green lanceolate leaves in the foreground; thick vertical green stalks in the left, center, and right. Middle-ground and top filled with numerous milky-white flowers with orange-yellow centers and wrinkled petals. Gaps show a clear blue sky. Harsh midday sun from the top-left illuminates the nose, cheeks, shoulders, and petals, while stalks and leaves cast thin shadows over the face, neck, and chest.

Composition/Camera:
3:4 aspect ratio. High-angle shot looking up from leaf height, a close-up portrait covering from the upper body to the overhead flowers. Subject takes up two-thirds of the height, face center-top, shoulders/chest bottom-left. Stalks placed vertically at edges. Focus on eyes and lips, slight blur on foreground leaves, medium depth of field for surrounding flowers.

Texture/Style:
High-definition photorealistic photo with a palette of vivid blue, deep green, milky white, orange-yellow, and natural skin tones. Precise depiction of wet hair/skin, swimsuit weave, thick stalks, translucent petals, and harsh summer shadows.

Negative:
Do not make the upward side profile a front-facing face; do not omit the long stalks or large flowers.
